modes.name: Free Spins
modes.effects:
FEATURE.

 In the FREE SPINS FEATURE, 10 free spins are awarded.
 Before the round starts, the player can select a symbol to
 be the special expanding symbol.
 During the FREE SPINS, after the payout of regular
 symbols, the special symbol expands vertically to cover all
 3 positions on the reel.
 The special expanding symbol pays according to its
 paytable, on all reels, even on non-adjacent positions.
 Expansion is triggered only if enough symbols for a win
 are present.

 Hitting 3 or more symbols during the FREE SPINS ROUND awards 10 more free spins with the currently
 selected special symbol. There is no limit to the number of possible re-triggers

features.name: Ante Bet
features.effects:
In the base game the player can opt to pay 10x current total for every spin. When the ante bet is on each spin is
played like a FREE SPINS feature spin. The player can preselect a special expanding symbol and all subsequent spins
 while on will have that symbol expand and pay anywhere like during FREE SPINS.
 When playing with ante bet symbol wins are according to base bet, not including the 10x
 increase paid for the SUPER SPIN feature.

features.name: Buy Free Spins
features.effects:
The FREE SPINS ROUND with 10 starting free spins can be instantly triggered from the base
 game by buying it for 100x current total bet.
